visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single-slide video carousel with prev/next chevrons and dot indicators
visualCharacteristics.layout: one rounded 16:9 video per slide at full width, swipeable; controls centred 30px below

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: a video link (link text = player title), optional poster image, optional caption paragraph (shown as a badge, e.g. "Generated with AI"). Optional rows "Previous | label" and "Next | label" name the arrows
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Swiper carousel of Dynamic Media videos (lml wave 2 testimonials)

usage: Life made lighter with quality weight loss testimonial videos.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2+ videos that should share one stage. For videos side by side use cards-video.
